svm.model: TF-IDF word 1-2-grams (50k features, min_df 2, sublinear tf) + one LinearSVC (C 1.0) per label, 3-fold project-grouped Platt calibration

hybrid_knn.architecture: sparse + dense retrieval kNN with reciprocal rank fusion (Cormack et al. 2009, k = 60)
hybrid_knn.model: TF-IDF 1-2-grams (50k) cosine + intfloat/multilingual-e5-base mean-pooled embeddings (max_length 256), 50 neighbours per retriever, RRF k 60, fused neighbour label vote

bilstm.model: release cordis_v0.5.0: 1-layer BiLSTM trained from scratch (300-d embeddings, 50k vocabulary, 256 hidden units per direction, dropout 0.2) with early stopping, which ended training after epoch 9 and kept the lowest-validation-loss epoch-7 checkpoint; then its sigmoid head refit on the frozen encoder (unweighted BCE, lr 1e-3); max_length 512

transformer.model: release cordis_v0.5.0: xlm-roberta-base fine-tuned for 3 epochs (lr 2e-5), then its sigmoid head refit on the frozen encoder for up to 20 epochs (unweighted BCE, lr 1e-3); max_length 512

naive_bayes.architecture: multinomial Naive Bayes over TF-IDF, one-vs-rest
naive_bayes.model: TF-IDF word 1-2-grams (50k features, min_df 2, sublinear tf) + one binary MultinomialNB per label, alpha 0.03

hard_majority.model: strict majority (more than M/2) of member label sets, member thresholds tuned on val-A

hard_k.model: k-of-M vote of member label sets, k tuned on val-B for micro-F1

hard_closed.model: k-of-M vote over ancestor-closed 586-node label sets, k tuned on val-B

soft.model: mean of raw member scores, global threshold tuned on val-B

weighted_soft.model: raw member scores weighted by val-A micro-F1, global threshold tuned on val-B

leave_one_out.model: strict majority of the M-1 members left after dropping each member in turn
